observedCompatibilityRisks: Donor validation reports 357 unique unresolved relative imports.
Donor validation reports 2178 TS2307 missing-module diagnostics after sanitization.
Donor web application is a second Next.js router/runtime and must not be mounted beside TanStack Start.
CLI/tool runtime assumes filesystem, shell, PTY and Node/Bun capabilities unavailable in Cloudflare Workers.
Donor QueryEngine uses a different model/protocol/service stack and must be adapted to OCADE's local WebGPU/WASM authority.
Donor Next file read/write routes resolve arbitrary paths and are not acceptable public web endpoints.
The existing OCADE repository already has agent loop, tool registry, browser Cowork, extension, local AI and permissions, so direct donor registration would duplicate authority.

observedReferenceStrings.note: These findings are classification/provenance observations, not evidence of an active hosted-model route.

recommendedStrategy: Preserve the archive under a quarantined import namespace, then port only reusable logic into the existing OCADE-native architecture with adapters and tests. Do not place the donor root directly under production src/.
